newsitem.title: USA: Clinton a "spoiled brat" - Republican leader.
newsitem.headline: Clinton a "spoiled brat" - Republican leader.

text.p: Senate Republican leader Trent Lott on Sunday accused President Bill Clinton of acting like a "spoiled brat" in a spat over tax cuts.
"He acts like a spoiled brat. He thinks he's got to have it his way or no way," Senator Trent Lott said on the ABC programme "This Week".
Lott and other Republicans have been wrangling with the White House over tax cut proposals in a deal to balance the federal budget.
Clinton on Sunday declined to been drawn into a slanging match with the powerful Republican leader.
"I wish him a happy Father's Day," the president told reporters after a holiday brunch with his wife and daughter at a local riverside restaurant.
